instruction: A candid martial arts photograph shows a full shot of two men on a black mat inside a studio with a textured brown wall. On the left, the man in the white gi (R1) is kneeling, leaning forward over his partner. On the right, the man in the gray gi (R2) kneels, tucking his head under the white gi's arm while gripping his sleeve. They are engaged in a close kneeling grapple, practicing transitions. Warm, soft indoor lighting casts gentle shadows on the wooden floor.
